title: Gemini 4 Neon Leaks in Google's API Docs Before Launch
dek: Specs and prices are live, but Google hasn't announced the model yet.
caption:
Google just published a model it hasn't announced 👀

Gemini 4 Neon appeared in the official Gemini API docs with a full model page and pricing, but no blog post, launch event or press release. The docs call it a "frontier-level" model for complex software engineering, knowledge work and science, with a 1 million token context window, computer use, function calling and Google Search grounding.

Listed pricing is $3 input and $15 output per million tokens, with no free tier. That places Neon between Gemini 4 Hydrogen and the top models like Gemini 4 Carbon. No benchmarks or release date yet.

We at AI Parabellum suggest developers hold off on changing production code. Treat this as a preview until Google confirms it, since draft pages and prices can still change.
